name: questionnaire_prompts
description: CRITICAL: Call this function with stage='start' IMMEDIATELY when a user asks to create, make, or start a new BUA form. This retrieves the required stage-specific conversational instructions for the LLM. You must use these exact prompts to gather information in a structured way at each stage of the BUA process.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.description: The current stage of the interview (e.g., 'start', 'project_and_pi', 'additional_contacts', 'personnel', 'room_usage', 'biological_agents', 'project_summary'). Use 'start' for new requests.

outputs.description: A dictionary containing the 'prompt_text' with specific stage instructions for the LLM.

output.prompt_text: Welcome to the BUA generator. Explain to the user that you will guide them...
